blockingIssues.problem: The idea omits a source-required precondition: the report specifies that before changing Narrative you must compare the actual input Synthesis feeding that Narrative (Implication for the next focused trial, point 1: “compare its actual input Synthesis before changing it”). The idea proposes a Narrative-focused control but does not state this prior inspection/compare step.
blockingIssues.correction: Add an explicit precondition to the proposed trial: before implementing any Narrative-focused control, inspect and record the Synthesis output that feeds each Narrative to be changed and compare it with the baseline Synthesis. Only apply Narrative changes after documenting that the Synthesis does not already contain the hierarchy drift; if Synthesis shows the first-visible drift, include Synthesis in the trial (or address it first) as the report prescribes.
